# @moul-dev/client

> The Moul SDK. It runs a backend inside a web page: a database with collections and records,
> access rules, sign-in, files, record subscriptions and live queries, stored as one SQLite file in
> the browser (OPFS) and optionally synced, as a Litestream replica, to an S3-compatible bucket or
> through a Moul Hub. The same client talks to a Moul server over HTTP.

Docs: https://github.com/moul-labs/moul/tree/main/docs

## Start

```ts
import { createClient } from '@moul-dev/client';
import type { MoulSchema } from './moul-types';      // from `moul typegen` or Studio
import schema from './moul.schema.json';              // collections, fields, rules

const moul = createClient<MoulSchema>({ db: 'myapp', schema });
```

- `db`: database name, `[A-Za-z0-9_-]+`. One database per name per site; tabs share it.
- `schema`: applied before the first request (creates and changes collections, deletes none).
  `await moul.ready` rejects if it did not apply.
- Vite: `optimizeDeps: { exclude: ['@moul-dev/client'] }` (the worker loads via `new URL(..., import.meta.url)`).

## Records

```ts
const c = moul.collection('tasks');
await c.create({ title: 'Mop', owner: moul.user!.id });   // optional `id` to choose it
await c.update(id, { done: true });                        // partial
await c.delete(id);
await c.get(id, { expand: 'project' });
await c.list({ filter: "done = false && owner = @request.auth.id", sort: '-createdAt', expand: 'project', page: 1, perPage: 50 });
// → { page, perPage, totalItems, totalPages, items }
await c.all({ filter }); await c.first(filter);
```

- `Blob`/`File` values are uploaded and stored as `{ id, url, filename, size }`.
- Errors throw `MoulError { status, message, data }`. A guest blocked by a rule gets 401/403; a
  record the caller may not view is 404.
- Record fields: `id`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`, then the collection's fields. Unset fields are
  `null` (bools too). Relation fields hold ids; `expand` puts related records under `expand`.

## Live queries (use these to show data)

```ts
const q = moul.collection('tasks').live({ filter: 'done = false', sort: 'due' });
const stop = q.subscribe(({ data, error, loading }) => render(data?.items ?? []));
```

Refreshes automatically after any commit that touches what it read (this tab, other tabs, other
devices, sign-in changes). `loading` is true until the first answer, and again after the
signed-in person changes until the query has read again (`data` is `undefined` meanwhile). Also
`liveGet(id)` (null when deleted/hidden), `liveAll(opts)`, `await q.value()`,
`moul.live(async () => ({ data, reads }))`, `moul.onChange(notice => …)` (engine in the page or
headless only; never fires over HTTP).

## Subscriptions

```ts
const stop = await moul.collection('tasks').subscribe((e) => {/* e.action, e.record, e.old_record */});
```

Options: `record`, `events`, `onClose`, `signal`, and `visible` (ids already shown: on a device that
follows another writer, deletes reach only subscribers that knew the record).

## Sign-in (auth collections, usually `users`)

```ts
const users = moul.auth('users');
await users.signUp({ email, password });                 // username made from the email if absent
await users.signInWithPassword(identity, password);      // email or username
await users.requestCode(email); await users.signInWithCode(email, code);
await users.refresh(); await users.signOut();
moul.user; moul.session; moul.onAuthChange(cb);
```

In a tab no mail is sent: codes and reset links go to the local inbox (`moul.admin.inbox()`, and
Studio's Inbox page).

## Rules (set per collection: listRule, viewRule, createRule, updateRule, deleteRule, subscribeRule)

Empty string = everyone, including guests, except on auth collections, where an empty list,
view, update or delete rule is stored as `id = @request.auth.id` (own account only); write `true`
to open one to everyone. No `!` operator: use `!=`, `!~`, `?!=`, compare a bool field or modifier with `false`
(`done = false`), and rewrite compound conditions (`a != 1 || b != 2`). List rules cannot use
`@request.body`.
Examples: `@request.auth.id != ''`,
`owner = @request.auth.id`, `@request.auth.id != '' && @request.body.owner = @request.auth.id`,
`status = 'published' || owner = @request.auth.id`. Also `@request.body.x:isset`, `:changed`,
`@collection.<name>.<field>`, relation paths in list rules (`project.owner = @request.auth.id`),
`@now`. Field names are camelCase (`^[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9]*$`); collection names `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$`.
In a tab the person at the keyboard owns the data; rules matter once the app is served to others.

## Schema file (`moul.schema.json`)

```json
{ "format": 1, "collections": [
  { "name": "users", "type": "auth", "fields": [{ "name": "name", "type": "text" }] },
  { "name": "tasks", "fields": [
      { "name": "title", "type": "text", "required": true },
      { "name": "done", "type": "bool" },
      { "name": "due", "type": "date" },
      { "name": "owner", "type": "relation", "relationConfig": { "targetMoul": "users", "cardinality": "1:N" } }
    ],
    "rules": { "listRule": "owner = @request.auth.id", "viewRule": "owner = @request.auth.id",
               "createRule": "@request.auth.id != '' && @request.body.owner = @request.auth.id",
               "updateRule": "owner = @request.auth.id", "deleteRule": "owner = @request.auth.id" } }
] }
```

Field types: text, number, bool, date, datetime, json, url, file, select (`"options": [...]`),
relation (`relationConfig: { targetMoul, cardinality: "1:1" | "1:N" | "M:N", onDelete: "CASCADE" | "SET_NULL" | "RESTRICT" }`).
Validate with `moul check [--json]` before applying.

## Files, database, sync, owner tools

- `moul.files.upload(blob)`, `moul.files.url(ref)` (blob URL for `<img>`), `moul.files.fetch(ref)`.
- `moul.database.status() | export() | download() | import(bytes) | persist()`.
- `moul.sync.configure({ endpoint, bucket, accessKeyId, secretAccessKey, label, followOnly? }) | status() | now() | takeOver() | disconnect()`.
  Settings read from a join link (`readJoinLink`) must be connected with `followOnly: true`.
- Moul Hub instead of a bucket: `const hub = new HubClient('https://sync.moul.dev')`; `hub.signIn(email)`,
  `hub.verify(email, code, { label })` → `{ token }`; `hub.databases(token)`, `hub.createDatabase(token, name)`;
  then `moul.sync.configure({ hub: hub.url, database, token, label })`. The token stays in the engine;
  `status().settings` shows `hub` and `database` only. Errors are `MoulError`.
- Hub join links carry a one-time ticket, never a token: `joinLink(await moul.sync.joinTicket(), page)`.
  `readJoinLink(url)` gives `{ hub, database, ticket }` for one (`'hub' in result`); connect with
  `moul.sync.configure(await joinHub(result, { label }))`, which follows only.
- `moul.admin`: collections CRUD, `schema()`, `applySchema(file, { prune })`, `types()`, `changes()`, `inbox()`, `testRule()`.
- `moul.asOwner()`: same engine, rules bypassed.

## Tests without a browser

```ts
import { createHeadlessClient } from '@moul-dev/client/headless';
const owner = await createHeadlessClient({ schema, owner: true, now: '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z', seed: 1 });
const app = new MoulClient(owner.transport, { authStorage: null });   // with rules
```

## Admin UI

`@moul-dev/studio`: `<moul-studio>` element; set `.client = moul` to share the engine.
